```{r setup}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(htmltools)

# Load datasets relative to this directory
panel_raw <- read_csv("../cee_taylor_panel.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
params_raw <- read_csv("../cee_taylor_parameters.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Ensure professional English country names across all datasets
country_en_map <- c("PL" = "Poland", "CZ" = "Czechia", "HU" = "Hungary", "RO" = "Romania")
panel_raw <- panel_raw %>% mutate(country_name = ifelse(country_code %in% names(country_en_map), country_en_map[country_code], country_name))
params_raw <- params_raw %>% mutate(country_name = ifelse(country_code %in% names(country_en_map), country_en_map[country_code], country_name))

# Color Palette according to dashboard-standards
col_pink       <- "#d6498b"
col_pink_area  <- "rgba(214, 73, 139, 0.18)"
col_yellow     <- "#fec44f"
col_yellow_area<- "rgba(254, 196, 79, 0.22)"
col_orange     <- "#fe9929"
col_orange_area<- "rgba(254, 153, 41, 0.18)"
col_seledyn    <- "#41b6c4"
col_seledyn_area <- "rgba(65, 182, 196, 0.18)"
col_line       <- "#111111"
col_grid       <- "#eeeeee"

# Filter baseline panel: HP Filter with CPI Inflation
# Baseline Natural Real Interest Rate r* = 1.0% (interactive baseline)
r_star_base <- 1.0

# Universal CSV Download Button helper matching Looker Studio / dashboard-standards
btn_csv_download <- function(title = "Download dataset as CSV") {
  tags$div(
    class = "chart-export-toolbar",
    style = "display: flex !important; flex-direction: row !important; justify-content: flex-end !important; align-items: center !important; width: 100% !important; margin-left: auto !important; margin-right: 0 !important; box-sizing: border-box !important;",
    tags$button(
      class = "btn-export-chart-csv",
      style = "margin-left: auto !important; margin-right: 0 !important;",
      onclick = "exportCardCsv(this)",
      title = title,
      HTML('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="btn-csv-icon" style="margin-right: 4px; vertical-align: -1.5px;"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"></path><polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"></line></svg><span>CSV</span>')
    )
  )
}

# 4-quarter rolling sum helper for Year-over-Year (YoY) inflation (Taylor 1993 standard)
calc_yoy <- function(x) {
  n <- length(x)
  yoy <- numeric(n)
  for (i in 1:n) {
    if (i < 4) yoy[i] <- x[i] * 4 else yoy[i] <- sum(x[(i-3):i])
  }
  round(yoy, 2)
}

# Calculate Canonical Taylor Rule with r* = 1.0% and explicit inflation target using YoY inflation
panel_base <- panel_raw %>%
  filter(gap_measure == "HP Filter", inflation_type == "CPI") %>%
  group_by(country_code) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(
    inflation_rate_yoy = if ("inflation_rate_yoy" %in% names(.)) inflation_rate_yoy else calc_yoy(inflation_rate_q),
    real_rate_ann = round(official_policy_rate_ann - inflation_rate_yoy, 2),
    # Taylor (1993) benchmark rule calculations
    taylor_1993_target_ann = round(r_star_base + inflation_target + 1.5 * (inflation_rate_yoy - inflation_target) + 0.5 * output_gap, 2),
    taylor_1993_gap_ann = round(official_policy_rate_ann - taylor_1993_target_ann, 2),
    taylor_1993_contrib_pi = round(1.5 * (inflation_rate_yoy - inflation_target), 2),
    taylor_1993_contrib_x = round(0.5 * output_gap, 2),
    # Canonical target: r* + pi* + phi_pi * (inflation_rate_yoy - inflation_target) + phi_x * output_gap
    canonical_target_ann = round(r_star_base + inflation_target + phi_pi * (inflation_rate_yoy - inflation_target) + phi_x * output_gap, 2),
    # Country-specific unsmoothed target decomposition
    target_gap_unsmoothed_ann = round(official_policy_rate_ann - canonical_target_ann, 2),
    country_contrib_pi = round(phi_pi * (inflation_rate_yoy - inflation_target), 2),
    country_contrib_x = round(phi_x * output_gap, 2),
    prev_policy_rate_ann = lag(official_policy_rate_ann, default = first(official_policy_rate_ann))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    canonical_implied_ann = {
      n <- n()
      implied <- numeric(n)
      implied[1] <- official_policy_rate_ann[1]
      for (i in 2:n) {
        rho <- smoothing_rho[i]
        lag_rate <- prev_policy_rate_ann[i]
        implied[i] <- rho * lag_rate + (1 - rho) * canonical_target_ann[i]
      }
      round(implied, 2)
    },
    canonical_gap_ann = round(official_policy_rate_ann - canonical_implied_ann, 2),
    canonical_stance = case_when(
      canonical_gap_ann < -0.5 ~ "Accommodative (Loose)",
      canonical_gap_ann > 0.5 ~ "Restrictive (Tight)",
      TRUE ~ "Aligned with Rule"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Extract by country (filtered from 2010 onwards)
pl_data <- panel_base %>% filter(country_code == "PL", date >= "2010-01-01")
cz_data <- panel_base %>% filter(country_code == "CZ", date >= "2010-01-01")
hu_data <- panel_base %>% filter(country_code == "HU", date >= "2010-01-01")
ro_data <- panel_base %>% filter(country_code == "RO", date >= "2010-01-01")
```

# Taylor Rule {#taylor-rule}

### Current Monetary Policy Rates & Interactive Taylor Rule Calculator (Latest: 2026-Q3)

```{r table-current-summary}
# Compute latest quarter summary table for 4 CEE countries
latest_summary <- panel_base %>%
  group_by(country_code) %>%
  filter(date == max(date)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    # Taylor (1993) benchmark rule: 0.5 on inflation deviation and 0.5 on output gap
    # i* = r* + pi* + 1.5 * (pi_YoY - pi*) + 0.5 * output_gap
    taylor_1993_ann = round(r_star_base + inflation_target + 1.5 * (inflation_rate_yoy - inflation_target) + 0.5 * output_gap, 2),
    rate_4q_proj = (smoothing_rho^4) * official_policy_rate_ann + (1 - smoothing_rho^4) * canonical_target_ann,
    country_label = paste0(country_name, " (", central_bank, ")"),
    official_fmt = sprintf("%.2f%%", official_policy_rate_ann),
    taylor_1993_fmt = sprintf("%.2f%%", taylor_1993_ann),
    implied_fmt = sprintf("%.2f%%", canonical_implied_ann),
    proj_4q_fmt = sprintf("%.2f%%", rate_4q_proj),
    gap_val = round(official_policy_rate_ann - rate_4q_proj, 2),
    stance_badge = case_when(
      gap_val > 0.5 ~ paste0("<span class='badge-stance badge-stance-restrictive'>Restrictive (", sprintf("%+.2f pp", gap_val), ")</span>"),
      gap_val < -0.5 ~ paste0("<span class='badge-stance badge-stance-loose'>Accommodative (", sprintf("%+.2f pp", gap_val), ")</span>"),
      TRUE ~ paste0("<span class='badge-stance badge-stance-aligned'>Aligned (", sprintf("%+.2f pp", gap_val), ")</span>")
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(country_name)

tagList(
  div(class = "card-header",
      tags$h3(class = "chart-title mb-2",
              "Current Central Bank Rates vs. Taylor Rule Targets and 4-Quarter Forward Projections"
      ),
      div(class = "taylor-subtitle-box w-100",
          div(class = "math-rule-row",
              tags$span(class = "math-rule-label", "Taylor (1993) Benchmark:"),
              tags$span(class = "math-formula", 
                        HTML("$$i_{c,t}^{*, \\text{Taylor}} = r^* + \\pi_c^* + 1.5(\\pi_{c,t} - \\pi_c^*) + 0.5 x_{c,t}$$")),
              tags$span(class = "math-rule-note", "[Uniform parameters across all countries: \\(\\phi_\\pi = 1.5\\), \\(\\phi_x = 0.5\\); controlled by the \\(r^*\\) slider]")
          ),
          div(class = "math-rule-row",
              tags$span(class = "math-rule-label", "Country-Specific Smoothing Rule:"),
              tags$span(class = "math-formula", 
                        HTML("$$i_{c,t}^* = r^* + \\pi_c^* + \\phi_{\\pi, c} (\\pi_{c,t} - \\pi_c^*) + \\phi_{x, c} x_{c,t} \\quad \\implies \\quad i_{c,t} = \\rho_c i_{c,t-1} + (1 - \\rho_c) i_{c,t}^*$$")),
              tags$span(class = "math-rule-note", "[Country-specific reaction \\(\\phi_{\\pi, c}\\), \\(\\phi_{x, c}\\) & smoothing persistence \\(\\rho_c\\) estimated via Bayesian MCMC, adjustable below]")
          ),
          div(class = "math-rule-row",
              tags$span(class = "math-rule-label", "Forward 4-Quarter Horizon:"),
              tags$span(class = "math-formula", 
                        HTML("$$i_{c, t+4} = \\rho_c^4 i_{c,t} + (1 - \\rho_c^4) i_{c,t}^*$$")),
              tags$span(class = "math-rule-note", "[Unchanged macroeconomic environment projection \\(t+4\\)]")
          )
      )
  ),
  div(class = "p-4",
      summary_table_html,
      div(class = "mt-2 mb-3 d-flex justify-content-end w-100", btn_csv_download("Download summary table as CSV")),
      div(style = "margin-top: 18px;", control_box_html)

)
```

### Central Bank Policy Rates vs. Taylor Rule Targets (2010-2026)

```{r plot-historical-rates}
#| padding: 0px

# Create main historical comparison plot with country selector dropdown
p1 <- plot_ly(height = 500)

# --- Poland (PL: Traces 1-4) ---
p1 <- p1 %>%
  add_lines(data = pl_data, x = ~date, y = ~official_policy_rate_ann,
            name = "Official Policy Rate (NBP)",
            line = list(color = col_line, width = 2.8),
            hoverinfo = "text",
            text = ~paste0("<b>Poland (NBP)</b><br>Date: ", quarter_str,
                          "<br>Official Rate: ", sprintf("%.2f%%", official_policy_rate_ann),
                          "<br>Real Rate (i - pi): ", sprintf("%+.2f%%", real_rate_ann),
                          "<br>Taylor Target (r*=1.0%): ", sprintf("%.2f%%", canonical_target_ann),
                          "<br>Implied Rate (Smoothed): ", sprintf("%.2f%%", canonical_implied_ann)),
            visible = TRUE) %>%
  add_lines(data = pl_data, x = ~date, y = ~real_rate_ann,
            name = "Real Policy Rate (Ex-post, i - pi)",
            line = list(color = col_line, width = 1.8, dash = "dash"),
            hoverinfo = "text",
            text = ~paste0("<b>Poland (NBP) Real Rate</b><br>Date: ", quarter_str,
                          "<br>Real Rate (Ex-post): ", sprintf("%+.2f%%", real_rate_ann),
                          "<br>Official Rate: ", sprintf("%.2f%%", official_policy_rate_ann),
                          "<br>YoY Inflation: ", sprintf("%.1f%%", inflation_rate_yoy)),
            visible = TRUE) %>%
  add_lines(data = pl_data, x = ~date, y = ~canonical_target_ann,
            name = "Taylor Target Rate (Unsmoothed, i*)",
            line = list(color = col_pink, width = 1.8, dash = "dot"),
            hoverinfo = "skip",
            visible = TRUE) %>%
  add_lines(data = pl_data, x = ~date, y = ~canonical_implied_ann,
            name = "Implied Rate (Smoothed, i)",
            line = list(color = col_seledyn, width = 2.2),
            hoverinfo = "skip",
            visible = TRUE)

# --- Czechia (CZ: Traces 5-8) ---
p1 <- p1 %>%
  add_lines(data = cz_data, x = ~date, y = ~official_policy_rate_ann,
            name = "Official Policy Rate (CNB)",
            line = list(color = col_line, width = 2.8),
            hoverinfo = "text",
            text = ~paste0("<b>Czechia (CNB)</b><br>Date: ", quarter_str,
                          "<br>Official Rate: ", sprintf("%.2f%%", official_policy_rate_ann),
                          "<br>Real Rate (i - pi): ", sprintf("%+.2f%%", real_rate_ann),
                          "<br>Taylor Target (r*=1.0%): ", sprintf("%.2f%%", canonical_target_ann),
                          "<br>Implied Rate (Smoothed): ", sprintf("%.2f%%", canonical_implied_ann)),
            visible = FALSE) %>%
  add_lines(data = cz_data, x = ~date, y = ~real_rate_ann,
            name = "Real Policy Rate (Ex-post, i - pi)",
            line = list(color = col_line, width = 1.8, dash = "dash"),
            hoverinfo = "text",
            text = ~paste0("<b>Czechia (CNB) Real Rate</b><br>Date: ", quarter_str,
                          "<br>Real Rate (Ex-post): ", sprintf("%+.2f%%", real_rate_ann),
                          "<br>Official Rate: ", sprintf("%.2f%%", official_policy_rate_ann),
```

```{r plot-country-target-gap}
                        HTML("Combo chart: Solid line shows target gap \\(\\text{Gap}_t^* = i_t - i_t^*\\) relative to the unsmoothed Bayesian target \\(i_t^*\\). Stacked columns display country reaction contributions: inflation \\(\\phi_{\\pi, c}(\\pi_t - \\pi^*)\\) and output gap \\(\\phi_{x, c} x_t\\)."))
      )
  ),
  p2b,
  btn_csv_download("Download country target gap data as CSV")
)
```
